newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends lower on year-end U.S. dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends lower on year-end U.S. dlr demand.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower on Saturday against its U.S. counterpart due to importers' year-end demand for the U.S. currency, but dealers did not expect sharp movements before the end of 1996.
The local unit ended at an intra-day low of T$27.505 against Friday's T$27.501 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$90 million.
The American currency was boosted further by its strength in overseas markets against the Japanese yen, dealers added.
"But I don't think the local dollar has too much room to fall further before 1997," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.49-51 range was seen for Monday.
